what: The rehearsal: a build performed without the build. Renders a cast ticket plus its standing chart berths as text, has the cheapest model (Haiku 4.5, via `claude -p --model claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 --output-format json`) read it three times cold and return a typed build tree per schema.json — one node per decision the ticket carries, exactly once, keyed by decision id (`D<n>`) or `unlisted: <text>` for a step the ticket never listed (D17, Akien's answer to open-d71a52522428; whether a decision is a step is not the reader's to judge, whether it builds is), each with state in builds_as_written | builds_under_assumption | cannot_proceed, assumption, would_settle, confidence, diffs the three trees by code into gaps of five kinds (step_absent, state, assumption, would_settle, unlisted), lets CC dispose each gap as a decision line on the ticket or a question in the inbox, and writes a clean rehearsal (three reads, zero gaps) to CairnCommons/rehearsals/ through the artifact door (verb rehearse). The BUILDME entry lane the_ticket_rehearses_clean (sieve buildme_rides_the_rehearsal in build_inspector) refuses a crossing without a clean record whose ticket hash still matches. A reading that fails the shape (a decision missing or doubled, a state outside the enum) is handed back to the same reader WITH its lacks named; the first attempt of every read stays cold (D1).
why: A ticket's buildability was a self-report by its own author (/sorted's builder_check: the same mind writes and judges), and the cost of a ticket that only reads as buildable lands on Akien's inbox and on Opus's build. Akien, 2026-09-15: 'we're not measuring yes it has field a but we're measuing if it can be built as written' — 'that gives us almost a hard gate on ticket quality equal to me. and then we run all our tickets thru it, and i don't have to approve them because we know they'll build as we meant.' The gate reads 'no reader has to assume', never 'Haiku's build is the build': the post-PROVED diff of the built proof against the converged tree is the gate's own measurement (Law 8 — a hollow green is worse than a red).
falsifier: DONE when `cairn rehearse <ticket>` over a deliberately underspecified fixture returns gaps naming the underspecified step in all three reads; with the gap answered as a decision line returns zero gaps; a BUILDME crossing without a clean rehearsal is refused by name; the crossing passes with one; a ticket edited after its rehearsal is refused again; the prompt asserts the reader's job is the tree and cannot_proceed is a legal answer. WRONG INTENT if over the first ten real tickets Opus's build diverges from the converged tree as often as from un-rehearsed tickets — then the reader measures Haiku's habits, not the ticket.
gates: proof gate (proofs/ under the tester in netns, reader stubbed — no proof tooth calls the real reader)
artifact door (records via verb rehearse; the ticket's rehearsal and decisions fields via verb cast)
WATCHME probe the_rehearsal_predicts_the_build (probes/) — the post-PROVED divergence list, enough at eight clean of ten
how_it_learns: Not yet, by design. v1 records every gap, every decision line and every post-PROVED divergence on the rehearsal record and learns nothing from them; the learning tree that asks the recurring questions before the first read is a child cast after ten records exist, because a tree trained on zero verdicts is the hollow learning the chart chain measured at 0.00. What the machine DOES carry between passes is not learning: a handed-back re-read is told what its previous reading lacked, within one pass only.
owner: CC builds it; codemother owns the care of the code (the lane and the sieve are inspector things, per ruling 2026-09-06-codemother-owns-the-care-of-the-code). The rehearsal records in the commons are records of truth gated by the artifact door.
invoke: CLI: `cairn rehearse <ticket>` prints the gaps; `cairn rehearse <ticket> --decide <step> "<line>" --by <provenance>` (step = D<n> or 'unlisted: <text>') appends a decision line D<n+1>; loop cap 5, the sixth pass opens a question on the ticket. Fired by /sail step 0c after the chart, before BUILDME. `cairn rehearse <ticket> --standing` prints what the lane reads; `--proved <proof path>` after PROVED records the divergence between the converged tree and the built proof's teeth (D14).
filed_edges: (a) transport: the claude CLI carries an 18.9k-token Claude Code preamble per call; a plain-API or inference_proxy transport is a follow-on ticket.
(b) the learning tree over recurring gaps: child cast after ten records.
(c) the reader has no repo access by design; a cannot_proceed naming a file the survey did not list is recorded as a finding against the chart's survey leg.

(d) a refused pass (three attempts all failing the shape) writes no record and its cost is unledgered; the record's ticket_sha256 covers the cursor, so `--standing` reads stale after any post-BUILDME crossing.
